empty  end
one [<a>] end

crlf [<a>,<b>][<c>] end
lf [<a>][<b>] end
trailing [<a>,<b>][<>] end

quoted-empty [<>,<x>] end

quoted-crlf [<a\r\nb>,<c>] end

cr-at-end [<a\r>] end
last-no-end [<a>,<b>] end
bare-quote err(csv: a quote stands in a field that is not quoted)err(csv: a quoted field is not closed) end
stray err(csv: text follows a quoted field)[<x>,<c>] end
unterminated err(csv: a quoted field is not closed) end
unterminated-empty err(csv: a quoted field is not closed) end
semicolon 2 b
w-empty \r\n
w-one a\r\n
w-two a,b\r\n
w-comma "a,b",c\r\n
w-quote "a""b",c\r\n
w-newline "a\nb",c\r\n
w-cr "a\rb",c\r\n
w-empty-fields ,\r\n

w-semicolon a;";b"\r\n
w-semicolon-quote "a;b";c\r\n
